title: bz-forecast-tsmixer: TSMixer-based IMF Bz forecasting and its application to geomagnetic index prediction
description: Model code, trained weights, test-set predictions, and scripts to reproduce every table and figure of Son, Kwak & Moon, 'Deep Learning-based IMF Bz Forecasting and Its Application to Geomagnetic Index Prediction', Space Weather. The model is a TSMixer trained on OMNI solar wind data (1998-2018) with jittering augmentation and an extremum-penalized loss, predicting IMF Bz 12 hours ahead during southward intervals. The predicted Bz is applied to the O'Brien-McPherron Dst model and to the deep learning SYM-H model of Son et al. (2026).
